findings.title: The step is launch bound
findings.evidence: the device is busy 5% of the step (617 of 11973 ms) over 42013 launches and 927899 operators per step, 273 us of host time per launch
findings.lever: graph replay (trainer.graph=true) removes the launch cost if the capture can use the same kernels

findings.title: Much of the module time has no cost model
findings.evidence: 2989 of 12451 ms is in modules the cost model does not know

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.in_layers (up)
findings.evidence: 431.5 ms per step against an ideal 12.5 ms (3% efficient, compute-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 9254 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn2 (up)
findings.evidence: 380.6 ms per step against an ideal 6.2 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 9254 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn1 (up)
findings.evidence: 351.9 ms per step against an ideal 6.2 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 9254 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.skip_connection (up)
findings.evidence: 295.5 ms per step against an ideal 1.5 ms (1% efficient, memory-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 9254 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: attention transformer_blocks.attn2 (down)
findings.evidence: 289.2 ms per step against an ideal 4.1 ms (1% efficient, compute-bound), 24 layers; all rated pieces together leave 9254 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Dtype and copy kernels take a large share
findings.evidence: 22% of device time is casts and copies
findings.lever: find the modules issuing `.to(dtype)` round trips (autocast boundaries, adapter branches) and keep one dtype through them

findings.title: Many small memory-bound kernels
findings.evidence: 40% of device time (25639 calls per step) is elementwise, normalisation, copy, memory and reduction work
findings.lever: fusion (fewer, larger kernels): norm + modulation, activation + multiply, cast + matmul input; half the time is the most a fusion usually recovers

findings.title: Module times do not add up to the device time
findings.evidence: modules account for 12451 ms of 617 ms device time per eager step
findings.lever: the difference is work outside the hooked modules (loss, optimizer, data movement) or host waits; see the phase and category tables
